about: The toys an explainer can name, and the task kinds each takes (README, "Toys"). The lesson player hosts every toy through one interface (game/docs/TOYS.md, #217); the full catalogue, one toy set per zone, is #221. A toy is added here before a script names it.

relay.name: The relay
relay.moves: A dial of whole numbers and a switch.
relay.shows: Every send on the board as in → out, and a pin on the map strip for the output.

fields.rule: The rule in x, as the board writes it (x² − 4).
fields.dial: The least and greatest whole numbers on the dial; [−5, 5] if left out.
fields.label: Optional: the name on the box, such as f.
fields.places: Optional: settlements on the map strip, by output.
fields.broken: Optional: a second rule, so each input gives two outputs (no longer a function).

relay.rigour: The dial sends only whole numbers, and the log shows only what was sent. The lesson makes it exact on paper: f(x) is the output for any input in the domain, worked by substitution.
